# Country is the host of the next Summer Games.
cw_oly_is_next_host = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.cw_oly_cur = 0 }
			has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_s_0
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.cw_oly_cur = 1 }
			has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_s_1
		}
	}
}

# Country and the next Summer host belong to two rival blocs.
cw_oly_opposes_next_host = {
	has_global_flag = cw_oly_next_host_known
	var:global.cw_oly_next_host = {
		exists = yes
		mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes
	}
}

	check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cw_oly_prog_close }
}

	check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cw_oly_boy_close }
